description: This file provides a client-side API wrapper for making HTTP requests to a backend server, including functions for building URLs, handling query parameters, parsing responses, and specific API calls such as listing users, sessions, deployments, and checking health status.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Detects if a given URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL from a base and a relative or absolute path, handling special cases like '/api' paths.

methods.name: toQuery
methods.description: Converts an object of parameters into a URL query string.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the fetch response, returning an object with ok, status, and payload (JSON or text).

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL with optional parameters, headers, and abort signal.

methods.name: httpJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with JSON payload, supporting methods like POST, PUT, DELETE.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload
methods.description: Normalizes API list responses to an object with items, total, and meta.
